# pantechdynamics_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up one certificate, requested or imported, by id or by one of its names, for example to give its id to a load balancer. Failed, revoked and expired certificates are skipped in a lookup by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a certificate up by one of its names (or by id).
data "pantechdynamics_certificate" "site" {
  name = "*.example.com"
}

output "expires" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_certificate.site.not_after
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the certificate, starting with cert_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) One of the certificate's names, such as "example.com" or "*.example.com". If more than one usable certificate has it, the lookup fails and lists their ids. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The common name, or null.
- `description` (String) The certificate's description.
- `exportable` (Boolean) Whether pantechdynamics_certificate_export can export it.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the certificate, lower-case hex, once issued.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer's name, once issued.
- `key_type` (String) The key's type, such as "ecdsa-p256".
- `kind` (String) "public" (Pantech requests and renews it) or "imported".
- `names` (List of String) Every name on the certificate; the first is the common name.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number, in hexadecimal, once issued.
- `status` (String) "pending_validation", "issuing", "issued", "renewing", "expired", "revoked" or "failed".
